497:t_000:25.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「I'm ready. To draw out this machine's potential, we'll need to use 100% of our Super Soldier abilities, too.」

497:t_000:26.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「My $$ガンダム$$'s output has also increased thanks to a revised control system. I should be able to fight better than ever.」

497:t_000:27.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I can use $$トランザム$$ now, too. Don't think the $$ガンダム$$s will have their way forever.」

497:t_000:28.en:
$$グラハム$$
(My friend, $$ビリー・カタギリ$$... I will master the power you gave the $$ブレイヴ$$.)

497:t_000:29.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I've confirmed $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s approach!」

497:t_000:30.en:
$$オットー$$
「They're coming! All units, prepare to intercept!!」

497:t_001:2.en:
$$レズン$$
「All units, spread out! How convenient! $$シャア・アズナブル$$ is on the front line, too!」

497:t_001:3.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「They haven't come in such great numbers.」

497:t_001:4.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「They may be an advance force. We can't let our guard down.」

497:t_001:5.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Then we simply need to strike their commander swiftly...!」

497:t_001:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's right! I'm counting on you, $$赤い彗星$$!」

497:t_001:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「Has the time come to settle things with $$ギュネイ$$?」

497:t_001:9.en:
$$シャア$$
「Don't worry, $$クェス$$. I've thought about how to settle things with him in my own way.」

497:t_001:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「First, I'll make contact with $$ギュネイ$$...! I cannot let him remain a man who fights for his personal feelings!」

497:t_001:12.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're coming, $$シャア$$! And $$カミーユ$$, too!」

497:t_001:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Today, I'll finally stop you, $$ギュネイ$$!」

497:t_001:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「You aren't the only one! I will stop $$ネオ・ジオン$$, which has lost its way!」

497:t_002:2.en:
$$レズン$$
「All units, spread out! How convenient! $$シャア・アズナブル$$ is on the front line, too!」

497:t_002:3.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「They haven't come in such great numbers.」

497:t_002:4.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「They may be an advance force. We can't let our guard down.」

497:t_002:5.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Then we simply need to strike their commander swiftly...!」

497:t_002:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's right! I'm counting on you, $$赤い彗星$$!」

497:t_002:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「Has the time come to settle things with $$ギュネイ$$?」

497:t_002:9.en:
$$シャア$$
「Please understand, $$クェス$$. I can't let him keep fighting for his personal feelings.」

497:t_002:11.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're coming, $$シャア$$! And $$カミーユ$$, too!」

497:t_002:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll stop you here, $$ギュネイ$$!」

497:t_002:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「You aren't the only one! I will stop $$ネオ・ジオン$$, which has lost its way!」

497:t_003:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Not yet! I won't go down yet!」

497:t_003:1.en:
$$クェス$$
「Stop it already, $$ギュネイ$$! You don't think $$フロンタル$$'s methods are right either!」

497:t_003:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Even so! Now that the Colonel is gone, I'll change $$ネオ・ジオン$$ from within!」

497:t_003:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! Abandon the name of $$ジオン$$! You'll never move forward if you cling to it!」

497:t_003:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You don't get to say that!」

497:t_004:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Do you understand how much hope the $$スペースノイド$$s placed in the name of $$ジオン$$!?」

497:t_004:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$ジオン$$ will change the world... It will change the lives of people living in this empty space...」

497:t_004:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Say those words again in front of the people who believed that, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

497:t_004:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Why are you silent, Colonel!?」

497:t_004:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Aren't you fighting to save everyone, regardless of whether they're with $$ジオン$$ or the Federation!?」

497:t_004:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And you don't have to shoulder everyone's future alone!」

497:t_004:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't chase after the Colonel, $$ギュネイ$$! If you want to save the $$スペースノイド$$s, do it with your own strength!」

497:t_004:13.en:
$$クェス$$
「You're a man, aren't you, $$ギュネイ$$!? Show us you can surpass the Colonel!」

497:t_004:16.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up, $$カミーユ$$! I...can't move forward until I defeat the Colonel!」

497:t_005:1.en:
$$フォウ$$
「People's wills...are gathering in the $$ゼータ$$...!」

497:t_005:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Space...is filled with people's souls...」

497:t_005:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I...understand what $$カミーユ$$ is saying...」

497:t_005:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You throw lives away in the grip of your emotions. I'll teach you what those souls mean...and the power they hold!!」

497:t_007:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's all right. He should have understood what my words meant.」

497:t_007:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「So he...believed in the god of space, too.」

497:t_007:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Only humans possess a god...the power to change the future... It is the god called possibility.」

497:t_007:6.en:
$$シャア$$
(I'm sorry, $$ギュネイ$$... My inadequacy made you suffer...)

497:t_007:7.en:
$$シャア$$
(I've made up my mind, too. In this battle...)

497:t_007:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Watch out! Their main force is coming!」

497:t_008:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If he keeps fighting out of his obsession with the Colonel, only ruin awaits him...」
